icons.name: beer-mug
icons.heading: Beer mug
icons.description: Cheers: the mug is raised and clinks. Light: the mug lifts and tips toward the right, stops dead at the clink as three sparks flash out from its rim, recoils a little and comes back down; the foam head sloshes on over the rim a beat behind the stop and settles. Strong: the mug draws back first, swings in harder to the clink, recoils and clinks a second, smaller time with a second flash, then comes down; the foam sloshes harder with a second swing. The glass stays rigid.

icons.name: cocktail
icons.heading: Cocktail
icons.description: Cheers: the glass is raised and clinks, and the drink takes the knock. Light: the glass lifts and tips toward the right while the drink stays level, stops dead at the clink, and the drink surges up the far wall and sloshes back once as the glass comes upright. Strong: the glass draws back first, swings in harder to the clink, recoils and clinks a second, smaller time; the drink surges higher and sloshes back and forth twice before it settles. The glass stays rigid. (There is no room for clink sparks: the tipped rim reaches within 3.4 of the right edge.)
